summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in tailwind-fabric@3.0.1
details: The package tailwind-fabric@3.0.1 was examined and no code paths were identified that read installer secrets, perform outbound network activity to attacker-controlled destinations, fetch and execute remote content at install or import time, ship third-party credentials, open a listener, or otherwise produce a supply-chain attacker benefit against the installing developer or build system. No lifecycle scripts triggering remote fetches or shell execution were observed, and no obfuscated or unpinned external code loads were present.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
